extract_fields.ExporterName: the value printed next to the 'Exporter:' heading
extract_fields.ExporterAddress: the value printed next to the 'Exporter Address:' heading
extract_fields.PackingDate: the value printed next to the 'Packing date:' heading
extract_fields.GGN: the 13-digit GGN number printed next to the 'GGN:' heading
extract_fields.PackRef: the value printed next to the 'Pack Ref:' heading
extract_fields.ExporterGLN: the number printed next to the 'GLN:' or 'GLN/COC:' heading beneath the Exporter Address
extract_fields.VarietyGroupName: the short variety group name (e.g. 'WHITE SEEDLESS', 'RED SEEDLESS') printed by itself in a large bold standalone box in the bottom-left corner of the label, below the Inv Code/Class boxes. This is a distinct printed box, not the Commodity or Name field. If this box is not present anywhere on the label, return null -- do not substitute the Commodity or Name value instead.
